name: Same invoice or shipment financed or invoiced multiple times
description: The same invoice, bill of lading or goods are presented to multiple financiers or invoiced more than once.

sources.text: FATF and Egmont Group, Trade-Based Money Laundering: Trends and Developments (2020)
ICC, trade finance fraud and BAFT guidance (general)
ACFE, Occupational Fraud 2024: A Report to the Nations (2024)
ICC, BAFT and Wolfsberg Group, Trade Finance Principles (2019 update)

links.name: Same invoice or bill of lading presented to multiple financiers
links.ctx: Duplicate financing detected by registry or internal matching.

links.name: Multiple invoicing for the same shipment
links.ctx: The same goods are invoiced or financed more than once, or payment references repeat.
links.fp: Partial shipments and amendments may seem like duplicates.
